links.outcome: Readability grade level of chatbot answers to bone sarcoma patient questions
links.effect: Readability scores averaged 10.28 for diagnosis questions to 11.65 for recovery questions; understandability was 84.30% but actionability was 64.58% for treatment and 60.64% for recovery questions.
links.quote: Readability scores averaged between 10.28 for diagnosis questions to 11.65 for recovery questions.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on their responses to common patient questions regarding bone sarcoma for accuracy, empathy, and readability without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
